neighbours.label: the possessive determiner 'its' (and Russian ее/его, Arabic ها) referring back to a thing or organisation
fire: The company announced that its profits fell last quarter.
Neither the name of the author nor the names of its contributors may be used.
The river floods every spring and its banks are covered in mud.
Sleep medicine has grown, and the treatment of its disorders improved.
The committee will appoint its own members at the next meeting.
Each cell divides only after its DNA has been copied.
The museum moved most of its paintings to a new wing.
The town council raised taxes to pay its debts.
